def fetch_deb(url, wanted):
    data=urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=180).read()
    pos=8; entries=[]
    while pos < len(data):
        hdr=data[pos:pos+60]
        if len(hdr)<60: break
        name=hdr[0:16].decode().strip().rstrip('/')
        size=int(hdr[48:58].decode().strip())
        entries.append((name,pos+60,size)); pos=pos+60+size+(size%2)
    name,start,size=[e for e in entries if e[0].startswith('data.tar')][0]
    blob=data[start:start+size]
    if name.endswith('.zst'): blob=zstandard.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(blob)).read()
    elif name.endswith('.xz'): import lzma; blob=lzma.decompress(blob)
    elif name.endswith('.gz'): blob=gzip.decompress(blob)
    tf=tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(blob))
    for m in tf.getmembers():
        if m.name.endswith(wanted):
            f=tf.extractfile(m); out='/workspace/tessdata/'+os.path.basename(m.name)
